external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app and kiosks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually change loan and member account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.

processes.name: app
processes.description: The library app on a member's phone, which calls the lending API to renew loans and reserve titles.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk that scans library cards and books and sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that receives app, kiosk and desk operations, checks loan rules, and reads or writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note says the lending API is internal-only, while Interview transcript says phones talk straight to it over the internet. The exposure therefore remains unknown.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The earlier two-database arrangement was corrected to one loans database; the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: renew or reserve
data_flows.description: The app sends a member and book or title request to the lending API for a loan renewal or reservation.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member
data_flows.notes: Priya said she thinks the app gets a token at sign-in, but could not confirm what the API accepts or does with rejected calls; authentication remains unknown.
data_flows.data_description: The requested book or title and member identity.

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan or return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: All desk staff use one shared login and the history cannot identify the individual or branch.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and member borrowing history.

trust_boundaries.name: phones
trust_boundaries.description: Member phones on which the library app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.
trust_boundaries.notes: Desk staff are also stated to work on this network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre environment where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The phones boundary is controlled by the member rather than the library.
assumptions.basis: The app is described as running on a member's phone, indicating a customer's own device.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing history.
assumptions.basis: Interview transcript states that these personal details and borrowing records live in the loans database.
